steps.action: long-presses a transaction card to enter selection mode
enters selection mode, highlights the long-pressed card, and shows a selection toolbar
taps additional cards to add or remove them from the selection
toggles selection state of each tapped card and updates the selected count in the toolbar
presses the Delete button in the toolbar
shows a confirmation dialog stating how many transactions will be deleted
deletes all selected transactions, clears the selection, and exits selection mode
